# Introduction

Figure S4B: paired bagging Random Forest to identify NanoString genes that
distinguish pre-treatment (W0) from on-treatment (W16) samples in patients
with successful treatment outcome (n = 33). Approximately 800 genes were
measured at W0 and W16 only. For each bootstrap iteration, patients are
sampled with replacement and both visits are included, preserving the paired
structure. Importance scores are averaged across all valid iterations.

Figure 3A: ROC curves with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for the top
genes identified by the Random Forest.

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(DataExplorer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
```


# Filter and recode

One barcode (0408230288) is excluded as a quality control outlier. Stimulation
labels are standardised to match the protein data naming convention.

```{r}
nano_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  mutate(
    Stimulation = ifelse(Stimulation == "TB",   "Mtb_Ag", Stimulation),
    Stimulation = ifelse(Stimulation == "NULL", "Null",   Stimulation),
    Visit       = paste0("W", Visit)
  ) %>%
  filter(!Barcode %in% "0408230288") %>%
  select(-Barcode)

cat(sprintf("Rows: %d | Columns: %d\n", nrow(nano_data), ncol(nano_data)))
cat(sprintf("Visits: %s\n",       paste(unique(nano_data$Visit),       collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Stimulations: %s\n", paste(unique(nano_data$Stimulation), collapse = ", ")))
```

# Variance filter at gene level

```{r}
meta_cols  <- names(nano_data)[1:4]
gene_cols  <- names(nano_data)[5:819]

variances      <- sapply(nano_data[, gene_cols], var, na.rm = TRUE)
retained_genes <- names(variances[variances > 0.1])

nano_data <- nano_data[, c(meta_cols, retained_genes)]

cat(sprintf(
  "Genes before filtering: %d | After filtering: %d\n",
  length(gene_cols), length(retained_genes)
))
```

# Average technical replicates and reshape to wide format

Some donors have technical replicates at the same visit and stimulation. These
are averaged before reshaping. Stimulation and gene name are combined into a
single column name so each stimulation-gene pair becomes a separate predictor.

```{r}
nano_long <- nano_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(retained_genes),
    names_to  = "Gene",
    values_to = "Count_log2"
  )

duplicates <- nano_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Visit, Comments, Stimulation, Gene) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cat(sprintf("Duplicate rows found: %d\n", nrow(duplicates)))

nano_log_wide <- nano_long %>%
  mutate(combined_name = paste(Stimulation, Gene, sep = "_")) %>%
  group_by(Donor, Visit, Comments, combined_name) %>%
  summarise(Count_log2 = mean(Count_log2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = combined_name,
    values_from = Count_log2
  )

cat(sprintf("Wide format: %d rows | %d columns\n", nrow(nano_log_wide), ncol(nano_log_wide)))
```

# Clean column names

Gene names can contain special characters that are invalid as R variable names.
A lookup table maps original names to cleaned names for reference.

```{r}
original_names <- names(nano_log_wide)
cleaned_names  <- make.names(original_names, unique = TRUE)

name_map <- data.frame(
  original = original_names,
  cleaned  = cleaned_names,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

names(nano_log_wide) <- cleaned_names

renamed <- name_map %>% filter(original != cleaned)
cat(sprintf("Columns renamed due to special characters: %d\n", nrow(renamed)))
```

# Helper functions

`prepare_rf_data`: filters to the visit pair, converts Visit to a valid factor,
removes low-variance features, and adds random reference features. The Comments
column is excluded because it is outcome-related metadata, not a predictor.

```{r}
prepare_rf_data <- function(wide_data, config) {
  visits             <- config$visits
  variance_threshold <- config$variance_threshold
  n_random           <- config$n_random
  patient_id_col     <- config$patient_id_col

  data_filt <- wide_data %>%
    filter(Visit %in% visits) %>%
    mutate(Visit = factor(Visit, levels = visits))

  levels(data_filt$Visit) <- paste0("W", gsub("W", "", levels(data_filt$Visit)))

  non_feature  <- c(patient_id_col, "Visit", "Comments")
  feature_cols <- setdiff(names(data_filt), non_feature)
  variances    <- sapply(data_filt[, feature_cols], var, na.rm = TRUE)
  retained     <- names(variances[variances > variance_threshold])
  data_filt    <- data_filt[, c(patient_id_col, "Visit", retained)]

  gene_vals <- unlist(data_filt[, retained], use.names = FALSE)
  rand_mean <- mean(gene_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  rand_sd   <- sd(gene_vals,   na.rm = TRUE)

  set.seed(123)
  random_cols <- paste0("Random_", seq_len(n_random))
  for (col in random_cols) {
    data_filt[[col]] <- rnorm(nrow(data_filt), mean = rand_mean, sd = rand_sd)
  }

  cat(sprintf(
    "Visits: %s | Rows: %d | Features retained: %d | Random added: %d\n",
    paste(visits, collapse = " vs "), nrow(data_filt),
    length(retained), n_random
  ))

  list(data = data_filt, retained = retained, random_cols = random_cols)
}
```

`tune_rf`: tunes `mtry` using patient-level grouped k-fold CV. All patients
are in the CV pool since there is no held-out test set.

```{r}
tune_rf <- function(prep, config) {
  data           <- prep$data
  k_folds        <- config$k_folds
  ntree          <- config$ntree
  mtry_range     <- config$mtry_range
  patient_id_col <- config$patient_id_col

  patient_ids <- data[[patient_id_col]]
  data_train  <- data[, !names(data) %in% patient_id_col]
  n_pred      <- ncol(data_train) - 1

  if (is.null(mtry_range)) {
    mtry_range <- seq(2, floor(sqrt(n_pred)), by = 1)
  }

  set.seed(123)
  group_folds <- groupKFold(patient_ids, k = k_folds)

  train_f1 <- unique(patient_ids[group_folds[[1]]])
  test_f1  <- unique(patient_ids)[!unique(patient_ids) %in% train_f1]
  cat(sprintf(
    "Fold 1 leakage check - Train: %d | Test: %d | Overlap: %d\n",
    length(train_f1), length(test_f1),
    length(intersect(train_f1, test_f1))
  ))

  ctrl <- trainControl(
    method          = "cv",
    index           = group_folds,
    classProbs      = TRUE,
    savePredictions = "final",
    summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
    verboseIter     = FALSE
  )

  set.seed(123)
  tuned <- tryCatch(
    train(
      Visit ~ .,
      data       = data_train,
      method     = "rf",
      trControl  = ctrl,
      tuneGrid   = expand.grid(mtry = mtry_range),
      ntree      = ntree,
      metric     = "ROC",
      importance = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) { message("Tuning failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )

  if (is.null(tuned)) stop("RF tuning failed.")

  best_mtry <- tuned$bestTune$mtry
  cat(sprintf("Best mtry: %d\n", best_mtry))
  print(tuned)

  best_mtry
}
```

`bag_rf`: paired patient-level bootstrap RF. For each iteration, patients are
sampled with replacement and both visits are included. Importance scores are
averaged and SD computed across all valid iterations.

```{r}
bag_rf <- function(prep, best_mtry, config) {
  data           <- prep$data
  n_bags         <- config$n_bags
  ntree          <- config$ntree
  patient_id_col <- config$patient_id_col

  patient_ids <- unique(data[[patient_id_col]])
  n_patients  <- length(patient_ids)
  imp_list    <- vector("list", n_bags)

  set.seed(123)
  for (b in seq_len(n_bags)) {
    sampled <- sample(patient_ids, n_patients, replace = TRUE)

    boot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sampled, function(p) {
      data[data[[patient_id_col]] == p, ]
    }))

    train_data       <- boot_data[, !names(boot_data) %in% patient_id_col]
    train_data$Visit <- droplevels(train_data$Visit)

    rf <- tryCatch(
      randomForest(
        Visit ~ .,
        data       = train_data,
        ntree      = ntree,
        mtry       = best_mtry,
        importance = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(rf)) {
      imp_list[[b]] <- importance(rf, type = 1, scale = TRUE)[, "MeanDecreaseAccuracy"]
    }
  }

  imp_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), imp_list)
  n_valid  <- length(imp_list)
  imp_mat  <- do.call(cbind, imp_list)

  cat(sprintf("Valid bags: %d / %d\n", n_valid, n_bags))

  list(
    avg_importance = rowMeans(imp_mat),
    sd_importance  = apply(imp_mat, 1, sd),
    n_valid_bags   = n_valid
  )
}
```

`plot_importance_fig`: dot plot of top features ranked by average MDA.
Features above the random threshold are shown in dark red.

```{r}
plot_importance_fig <- function(importance_vals,
                                rand_threshold,
                                title     = "Variable importance",
                                save_path = NULL,
                                filename  = "importance.png",
                                top_n     = 75) {

  sorted_vals <- sort(importance_vals, decreasing = TRUE)
  n_show      <- min(top_n, length(sorted_vals))
  top_vals    <- sorted_vals[seq_len(n_show)]
  y_pos       <- n_show:1
  dot_colors  <- ifelse(top_vals > rand_threshold, "darkred", "gray60")
  n_sig       <- sum(
    importance_vals[!grepl("^Random_", names(importance_vals))] > rand_threshold
  )

  draw_plot <- function() {
    par(mar = c(5, 12, 4, 2))

    x_min <- min(top_vals) * ifelse(min(top_vals) < 0, 1.1, 0.9)
    x_max <- max(top_vals) * 1.2

    plot(top_vals, y_pos,
         type = "n", xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
         yaxt = "n", xaxt = "n",
         xlab = "Mean Decrease in Accuracy", ylab = "", main = title)

    axis(1, at = seq(floor(min(top_vals)), ceiling(max(top_vals)),
                     by = max(0.5, round(ceiling(max(top_vals)) / 5, 1))))
    abline(h = y_pos, lty = "dotted", col = "gray80")
    points(top_vals, y_pos, pch = 16, cex = 1.2, col = dot_colors)
    text(par("usr")[1], y_pos, labels = names(top_vals),
         pos = 2, xpd = TRUE, col = "black", cex = 0.9)
    abline(v = rand_threshold, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

    usr <- par("usr")
    text(usr[2] - (usr[2] - usr[1]) * 0.02,
         usr[3] + (usr[4] - usr[3]) * 0.05,
         labels = paste("Random threshold:", round(rand_threshold, 3)),
         adj = c(1, 0), cex = 1, col = "gray40")
    mtext(paste(n_sig, "genes above random threshold"),
          side = 3, line = 0.5, cex = 0.8)
  }

  draw_plot()

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    png(file.path(save_path, filename), width = 2600, height = 4500, res = 300)
    draw_plot()
    dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", filename))
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

`run_roc`: patient-level bootstrap ROC. Uses `vapply` for faster bootstrapping
and pre-indexes patients once to avoid repeated full-dataframe scans.

```{r}
run_roc <- function(data, gene, patient_id_col = "Donor", n_bootstrap = 500) {
  tryCatch({
    response  <- data$Visit == levels(data$Visit)[1]
    predictor <- data[[gene]]
    pid       <- data[[patient_id_col]]

    roc_obj <- roc(response, predictor, direction = "auto", quiet = TRUE)

    patient_index <- split(seq_along(pid), pid)
    patient_names <- names(patient_index)
    n_patients    <- length(patient_names)

    boot_aucs <- vapply(seq_len(n_bootstrap), function(b) {
      boot_idx <- unlist(
        patient_index[sample(patient_names, n_patients, replace = TRUE)],
        use.names = FALSE
      )
      boot_roc <- tryCatch(
        roc(response[boot_idx], predictor[boot_idx],
            direction = "auto", quiet = TRUE),
        error = function(e) NULL
        )
      if (!is.null(boot_roc)) as.numeric(auc(boot_roc)) else NA_real_
    }, numeric(1))

    boot_aucs <- boot_aucs[!is.na(boot_aucs)]

    list(
      roc          = roc_obj,
      auc          = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
      ci_lower     = quantile(boot_aucs, 0.025),
      ci_upper     = quantile(boot_aucs, 0.975),
      n_valid_boot = length(boot_aucs)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("ROC failed for ", gene, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
}
```

`plot_roc_curves`: ROC curves with AUC and CI in the legend.

```{r}
plot_roc_curves <- function(roc_results,
                             title     = "ROC curves",
                             save_path = NULL,
                             filename  = "roc.png") {

  colors <- c("#000000", "#00CCFF", "#33CC66", "#9933CC")

  draw_plot <- function() {
    par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
    plot(roc_results[[1]]$roc,
         col = colors[1], main = title,
         xlab = "1 - Specificity", ylab = "Sensitivity",
         lwd = 2, cex.main = 1.2, cex.lab = 1.1, cex.axis = 1.0,
         legacy.axes = TRUE)

    if (length(roc_results) > 1) {
      for (i in seq(2, length(roc_results))) {
        plot(roc_results[[i]]$roc, col = colors[i], add = TRUE, lwd = 2)
      }
    }

    grid()

    legend("bottomright",
           legend = sapply(names(roc_results), function(g) {
             r <- roc_results[[g]]
             sprintf("%s  AUC = %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f - %.2f)",
                     g, r$auc, r$ci_lower, r$ci_upper)
           }),
           col = colors[seq_along(roc_results)],
           lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 0.9, bg = "white", box.lwd = 1)
  }

  draw_plot()

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    png(file.path(save_path, filename), width = 1800, height = 2000,
        res = 300, bg = "white")
    draw_plot()
    dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", filename))
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

`build_summary`: summary table with AUC, CI, and Youden threshold metrics.

```{r}
build_summary <- function(roc_results) {
  get_coords <- function(roc_obj) {
    opt <- coords(roc_obj, x = "best", best.method = "youden",
                  ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv"),
                  transpose = FALSE)
    if (nrow(opt) > 1) opt <- opt[which.max(opt$sensitivity), ]
    opt
  }

  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(roc_results), function(g) {
    r   <- roc_results[[g]]
    opt <- tryCatch(get_coords(r$roc), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(opt)) return(NULL)

    data.frame(
      Gene              = g,
      AUC               = round(r$auc, 3),
      CI_Lower          = round(r$ci_lower, 3),
      CI_Upper          = round(r$ci_upper, 3),
      Optimal_Threshold = round(opt$threshold, 4),
      Sensitivity_pct   = round(opt$sensitivity * 100, 1),
      Specificity_pct   = round(opt$specificity * 100, 1),
      PPV_pct           = round(opt$ppv * 100, 1),
      NPV_pct           = round(opt$npv * 100, 1),
      Youden_J          = round(opt$sensitivity + opt$specificity - 1, 3),
      N_Bootstrap       = r$n_valid_boot,
      stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
    )
  }))
}
```

`query_gene`: runs ROC for a single gene and prints a concise summary. Use
`name_map` to find the cleaned version of a gene name if needed.

```{r}
query_gene <- function(gene_name,
                       data           = nano_log_wide,
                       patient_id_col = "Donor",
                       n_bootstrap    = 500,
                       gene_mda       = NULL,
                       rand_threshold = NULL) {

  if (!gene_name %in% names(data)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "Gene not found: %s\nCheck name_map for the cleaned version of this name.\n",
      gene_name
    ))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  set.seed(123)
  result <- run_roc(
    data           = data,
    gene           = gene_name,
    patient_id_col = patient_id_col,
    n_bootstrap    = n_bootstrap
  )

  if (is.null(result)) return(invisible(NULL))

  opt <- tryCatch({
    o <- coords(result$roc, x = "best", best.method = "youden",
                ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv"),
                transpose = FALSE)
    if (nrow(o) > 1) o <- o[which.max(o$sensitivity), ]
    o
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  mda_val      <- if (!is.null(gene_mda) && gene_name %in% names(gene_mda)) gene_mda[[gene_name]] else NA
  above_thresh <- !is.na(mda_val) && !is.null(rand_threshold) && mda_val > rand_threshold

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n%s\nAUC: %.3f  |  95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f  |  Bootstrap n: %d\n",
    gene_name, result$auc, result$ci_lower, result$ci_upper, result$n_valid_boot
  ))

  if (!is.na(mda_val)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "MDA: %.3f  |  Above random threshold: %s\n",
      mda_val, ifelse(above_thresh, "Yes", "No")
    ))
  }

  if (!is.null(opt)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "Optimal threshold: %.4f  |  Sensitivity: %.1f%%  |  Specificity: %.1f%%\n",
      opt$threshold, opt$sensitivity * 100, opt$specificity * 100
    ))
    cat(sprintf(
      "PPV: %.1f%%  |  NPV: %.1f%%  |  Youden J: %.3f\n",
      opt$ppv * 100, opt$npv * 100, opt$sensitivity + opt$specificity - 1
    ))
  }

  invisible(result)
}
```

# Visit 0 vs Visit 16 (Figures 3A and S4B)

```{r}
prep_16 <- prepare_rf_data(nano_log_wide, rf_config$W0_W16)
mtry_16 <- floor(sqrt(ncol(prep_16$data) - 2)) 
cat(sprintf("Default mtry: %d\n", mtry_16))
bag_16  <- bag_rf(prep_16, mtry_16, rf_config$W0_W16)
```

```{r}
avg_imp_16   <- bag_16$avg_importance
is_rand_16   <- grepl("^Random_", names(avg_imp_16))
threshold_16 <- mean(avg_imp_16[is_rand_16])
gene_mda_16  <- avg_imp_16[!is_rand_16]
sig_16       <- sort(gene_mda_16[gene_mda_16 > threshold_16], decreasing = TRUE)
top_genes_16 <- names(head(sig_16, rf_config$W0_W16$top_n_genes))

cat(sprintf(
  "Threshold: %.3f | Genes above threshold: %d | Top %d: %s\n",
  threshold_16, length(sig_16), length(top_genes_16),
  paste(top_genes_16, collapse = ", ")
))
print(sig_16)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 14

plot_importance_fig(
  importance_vals = avg_imp_16,
  rand_threshold  = threshold_16,
  title           = "Variable importance: Visit 0 vs Visit 16",
  save_path       = output_fig3a_s4b,
  filename        = "S4B_importance_W0_W16.png"
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
roc_16 <- list()
for (gene in top_genes_16) {
  cat(sprintf("ROC: %s\n", gene))
  roc_16[[gene]] <- run_roc(
    data           = prep_16$data,
    gene           = gene,
    patient_id_col = rf_config$W0_W16$patient_id_col,
    n_bootstrap    = rf_config$W0_W16$n_bootstrap_roc
  )
}
roc_16 <- Filter(Negate(is.null), roc_16)

for (gene in names(roc_16)) {
  r <- roc_16[[gene]]
  cat(sprintf("  %-30s AUC: %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f) | Bootstrap n: %d\n",
              gene, r$auc, r$ci_lower, r$ci_upper, r$n_valid_boot))
}
```

```{r}
)
```
